kinds.in_situ: Measured on site by an instrument (for example a weather station).
kinds.satellite_retrieval: Retrieved from satellite measurements (including products that merge satellites with gauges).
kinds.model: Computed by a model or reanalysis (land-surface model, atmospheric reanalysis, or fields derived from one).

note: Rules are tried in order; the first match wins. A rule matches on variable_id (exact), variable_pattern (regular expression on the variable id) and/or product_pattern (regular expression on the product); every key present in the rule must match.

rules.note: GLDAS_NOAH025_M.2.1 Tair_f_inst: a forcing input of the GLDAS model run, taken from the NOAA GDAS atmospheric analysis; not an output of the land-surface model and not a station measurement (docs/data/gldas-tair-check.md).

GLDAS Noah forcing field (variable name ends in _f_): a meteorological input of the model run (NOAA GDAS analysis, GPCP precipitation, AGRMET radiation per the GLDAS-2 README), not an output of the land-surface model.
NASA POWER, which serves MERRA-2 reanalysis fields.
GPM IMERG Final: merged satellite-gauge precipitation estimate.
